summary: Pan American Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated October 7, 2026, announcing timing of its third quarter 2026 unaudited financial results and related conference call. Results will be released after market close on November 4, 2026, with a call and webcast at 10:00 am ET on November 5, 2026. The release also provides routine corporate background, including its 44% Juanicipio joint venture interest and the non-operating Escobal mine. No transaction, shareholder solicitation, or structural event is disclosed; this is an ordinary earnings-scheduling announcement, mapping to a US Form 8-K disclosure.
